items.title: Bomb threats disrupt several flights across Europe
items.description: At least a dozen flights were either diverted or landed with a military escort after bomb or security threats. The first reported case involved a flight from Dublin to Rome landing outside Paris and more soon followed.

items.title: Hoax bomb threats target European airlines and airports for second time in a week
items.description: At least 21 flights across Europe are affected in what the UK government calls a "malicious hoax threat".

items.title: Who could be behind hoax bomb threats to European air travel?
items.description: There is no hard evidence so far linking airline bomb threats to Russia, Iran or any proxy groups.

items.title: EU court says CBD foods need approval for sale before they can be certified organic
items.description: The EU's top court says CBD foods cannot be certified organic without approval for sale. The ruling concerns a cannabis compound whose use in food requires authorization, including before organic certification.

items.title: North Korea tells EU to 'mind its own business' on human rights
items.description: North Korea's UN mission has lashed out at the European Union over a draft UN resolution. Pyongyang has said the West does not have a monopoly on human rights.
